method.cold: Flush before each mode/sample request; alternate order by repetition+sample position
method.warm_stream: Flush once per mode stream; fixed sample order; alternate mode order by repetition
method.cold_reference: Both independently flushed modes from this run, matched by pair/repetition/source_uid/sample_index; warm-full is descriptive, not a cold oracle
method.requests: Sequential, same input IDs, native zero-generation payload; one aiohttp session per request
method.order_limit: One repetition cannot balance both first-mode positions for each individual sample
method.timing: perf_counter; headers include request serialization/server work; decoded body read, JSON parse and native tail validation measured separately
method.acceptance: No performance PASS or numerical tolerance; primary judges observed differences
